# ACX schema snapshots

These ACX 0.1 Manifest/Receipt schemas were copied from the user-provided `acx` checkout on 2026-09-26. The experimental Node Graph Intent schema is maintained in `acx/schemas/profiles/acx-node-graph-intent.schema.json`; this snapshot lets UNGE run and export without that symlink.

Upstream project: ACX — Agent Capability Exchange. Its README proposes CC BY 4.0 for specification text and Apache-2.0 for reference code. These upstream schema snapshots retain that provenance; UNGE's root source-code license does not replace it.

Update the snapshots and `docs/ACX_NODE_GRAPH_PROFILE.md` when changing the profile. Run `scripts/test_acx.py` for cross-language/schema checks. This is an experimental profile, not a mandatory ACX core extension.
